npcs.name: Pickpocket Villager
npcs.description: Common traveller in towns. Easy target with minimal rewards.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Cake Stall
npcs.description: Steal from unattended cake stalls. Better rewards than basic NPCs.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Farmer
npcs.description: Agricultural workers. Slightly better than townspeople.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Gardener
npcs.description: Tend to gardens in various locations. Profitable early-level target.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Baker
npcs.description: Work in bakeries across the realm. Good XP for the level.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Master Farmer
npcs.description: A simple man who cares about plants. Rewards seeds and saplings instead of coins, but takes longer to pickpocket.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Guard
npcs.description: Armoured guards. Dangerous targets. Significant coin rewards.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Knight
npcs.description: Well-armed knights. High XP and coin rewards.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Ardounne Knight
npcs.description: Elite city guard. Excellent experience and profit.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Vyre
npcs.description: Mysterious Vyre people. High risk, high reward endgame target.

npcs.name: Pickpocket Elf
npcs.description: Magical forest dwellers. Ultimate pickpocketing challenge with massive rewards.

npcs.name: Steal from Tzraar
npcs.description: A gem-hoarding merchant. Steal cut gems at the Jeweller's rate — the ultimate high-level thieving target.

actions.name: Hunt Cow
actions.description: A small, docile creature. Good for beginners.

actions.name: Hunt Wizard
actions.description: A spell-casting NPC. Drops magical staves and runes.

actions.name: Hunt Jeweller
actions.description: A crafter of fine jewellery. Drops gems and amulets.

actions.name: Hunt Herbi
actions.description: A skittish forager draped in foraged herbs of every kind.

actions.name: Hunt Master Trader
actions.description: An elite merchant with rare treasures.
